notes: Read SKILL.md in full. The skill covers Firebase CLI setup, Firestore security rules and data access, Auth, Cloud Functions v2, Hosting config with security headers, emulators, environment config, and multi-project deploys.

Following it can make the agent install firebase-tools globally (npm install -g), log in with the user's Google account, and run firebase deploy against staging or production projects (SKILL.md:44-50, 314-316). Deploying is the user's own release task and the skill recommends separate staging/production projects and local emulators first, so medium risk is acceptable; production deploys should be confirmed with the user.

Secrets shown are placeholders (sk_live_xxx). functions:config:set (SKILL.md:290) is a deprecated Firebase API. Related-skill links (../../cloud-gcp/gcp-cloud-functions/, ../vercel-deployments/, ../convex-backend/ at SKILL.md:362-364) are optional pointers.
